Investments on a phone

Sample data, made up

The same order as the picked page (L1 Giant): greeting, the holdings strip that picks what to look at, the dark stage (the big number, the chart, go back to a day, Worth or Race, the range), then the returns, the holdings as cards, the cash at your brokers, money in, and the rest. A holding opens its lens, and Add trade is a bottom sheet; Edit a trade (from the pencil on a trade in a holding's lens) is the same sheet filled in, with what changed marked and a Delete trade button under Save. The last phone is the How it is split card with its Spin wheel | Treemap toggle (the wheel stacked above its list). The stage, the split toggle and its slice chips are live here.
